items.why: The viewer catches the book title introduction, but the acting Dracula and deed stage make it sound like Dracula is acting on a deed rather than describing hairy palms and a scratching pen.
The "TRAPPED INSIDE" label and Jonathan changing lead the viewer to think Jonathan transforms and is trapped indoors instead of making an isolated journey through the mountains.
Showing Jonathan changing alongside the wall-scaling label without Dracula makes the viewer think Jonathan is climbing the outer wall instead of watching Dracula do it.
Crossing out the deed and showing Carfax and the earthbox facing collapse accurately conveys that losing the estate's legal beachhead dooms the plan.
Abstract change, burst, and separation cues on the two character figures hide Dracula's lunge and recoil from Harker's crucifix.
The viewer correctly understands that Dracula forces a blood baptism on Mina while Jonathan fades incapacitated into the background.
Using a state change on Dracula next to the shaking box makes the viewer think Dracula is transforming inside the box rather than being driven in a racing cart through snow.
